name: R-21: external contributions have a source-of-truth path and a configured CLA check
summary: At the launch commit CONTRIBUTING.md explains that accepted pull requests are applied in the private development tree and re-exported (the PR is closed with a link, not merged), and names the CLA; CLA.md is present; cla.yml runs contributor-assistant on pull_request_target/issue_comment, checks out no PR code, and records signatures on the cla-signatures branch.

assertions.evidence: CONTRIBUTING.md: 'When we accept a pull request, we apply the change in the development tree' ... 'The pull request itself is not merged directly.'
CONTRIBUTING.md names the Contributor License Agreement (CLA) and the bot flow
CLA.md present at launch commit, 3207 bytes, first line '# Papercusp Individual Contributor License Agreement'
cla.yml uses contributor-assistant/github-action@v2.6.1 with path-to-document CLA.md, signatures on branch cla-signatures
cla.yml has no actions/checkout step; it only reads comments and writes signatures

limitations: No external pull request has been opened yet, so the CLA bot's live comment flow is verified from configuration, not from an observed PR.
